fields.headline: Accepts two state grant amendments adding $1.7M for services to unaccompanied youth, raising the grant total to $2.2M
fields.summary: The board approves two amendments to a California Department of Social Services grant for the Opportunities for Youth project, which provides case management, mental health, mentoring and other support to unaccompanied youth living with sponsors in California. The attached amendments raise the grant maximum from $500,000 to $1,100,000 (adding $600,000, through December 31, 2023) and then to $2,199,877 (adding $1,099,877 for January 1 to June 30, 2024). The agenda lists $1,100,000 and $1,099,877 as maximums, not as added amounts. The state signed Amendment 1 in June 2022, but the district never countersigned it, so it is being approved now.

23-2931.note: Corrected: the $1,100,000 and $1,099,877 in the agenda are grant maximums, not added amounts. Per the attached amendments, this vote adds $1,699,877 and raises the grant maximum from $500,000 to $2,199,877.
23-2931.sourceIssue: The text lists $1,100,000 and $1,099,877 as grant maximums for the two amendments without saying the first is a cumulative maximum (up from $500,000) and the second is added on top of it; the attached amendments show a combined maximum of $2,199,877.
